author: pablobm
body: My thoughts on this one: - The restrictions exist and DWG don't appear to be particularly interested in changing them. Also as mentioned their origin appears to be lost in the mist of time. Therefore, I think we don't need to wait for anything: the behaviour exists and is unlikely to change. - Perhaps this should be scoped down a bit, to just copy the same behaviour that exists for user blocks. For example, if you try to edit a user block created by a different user, you get a message "Only the moderator who created this block can edit it without revoking" - This PR looks like AI slop to me. For one, any solution should reuse existing logic when available.
